chunks: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who performed Hajj as ifrād: may he perform ʿumrah after the hajj? He said: “Yes, when the razor has reached his head, then it is good.”

key_terms.أَفْرَدَ: performed Hajj in the ifrād form, without combining it with ʿumrah
key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, meaning the head being shaved or cut as part of ritual completion
key_terms.فَحَسَنٌ: then it is good or acceptable
key_terms.ٱلْمُوسَىٰ: the razor, referring to shaving the head in the pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: Can a person who performed Hajj al-Ifrād do ʿumrah after completing hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performed Hajj al-Ifrād. It states that he may perform ʿumrah after hajj once the rite of shaving or cutting the hair has been completed, indicating the completion of that stage of the pilgrimage.
